description.value: Your tongue can momentarily latch on as readily as your hands. So long as you can freely open your mouth, you do not need free hands in order to @UUID[Compendium.avant.actionsavant.Item.Disarm], @UUID[Compendium.avant.actionsavant.Item.Grab an Edge], @UUID[Compendium.avant.actionsavant.Item.Reposition], or @UUID[Compendium.avant.actionsavant.Item.Trip]. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.avant.feats-srd.Item.Long Tongue] feat, you can Disarm, Grab an Edge, Reposition, and Trip with your tongue at a distance that is 5 feet beyond your normal reach.
